items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: Memphis, uh, Lewis. Lewis. Memphis Lewis.

ctx.x: It wouldn't do. So you got tired of that? You didn't like what they were.
Well, lollipops. I don't know whether you heard of him. Lollipop. Yeah, lollipop Jones. Lollipop Jones in Memphis. Memphis, uh, Lewis. Lewis. Memphis Lewis.

Oh, you know some shit. Oh man, I told you, I could come into these things, you gotta know some things, you know? You know, just, uh, come in here and scare them, you know? I know, but I've been in a while to interviews with him and you know some shit nobody else knows. I know, you don't think I'm gonna come in here half-cum.
